background.$description: Page canvas. Use instead of card when the surface is the window, not a raised panel.

card.$description: Raised panel on the canvas. Use instead of background for a contained block.

popover.$description: Overlay surface. Same swatch as card; use for menus and dropdowns, not page panels.

secondary.$description: Quiet fill behind a secondary control. Use instead of muted when the fill is a button, not a well.

muted.$description: Recessed well. Use instead of secondary when the block is not a control.

control.$description: Fill of a control that is not the primary action — switch off-track, field interior, disabled fill. Use instead of border.input, which is a hairline.

accent.$description: Brand chrome that is not the primary button. Fill only on light — never as text.

foreground.$description: Default copy on background or card. Use instead of muted whenever the line must be read, not glanced.

muted.$description: Supporting copy on light. Darker than the invert of the landing 50% grey so AA holds on canvas and card. Do not use on muted surfaces.

secondary.$description: Darker supporting copy than muted. Use when muted is too faint; this pair passes AA on the light canvas.

card.$description: Default copy on a card. Same swatch as text.foreground; keep the role for surfaces that are not the canvas.

popover.$description: Default copy on a popover. Same swatch as text.card; use only inside overlays.

primary.$description: Primary button fill. Not text on light — citron on the light canvas fails contrast.

primary-foreground.$description: Text and icons on a primary fill. Use instead of text.foreground, which is for the canvas, not citron.

accent.$description: Selected or hover accent fill. Same rule as primary: fill only on light.

accent-foreground.$description: Text on an accent fill. Same swatch as primary-foreground; keep the role next to action.accent.

destructive.$description: Danger text and fill on light. Darker than the landing red so AA holds on canvas and card. Do not use on muted surfaces.

destructive-foreground.$description: Text on a destructive fill. Passes AA against red.700. Landing does not show that button.

default.$description: Hairline between surfaces. Decorative — it does not meet 3:1 against the canvas.

input.$description: Field edge. Same swatch as border.default; use on controls, not panels.

ring.$description: Focus ring. Use instead of border.default when the edge must show keyboard focus.
